focus_areas.title: Our Focus Areas
focus_areas.subtitle: We develop, implement, and create sustainable impact across 9 activity areas defined in our charter.

education.title: Educational Institutions
education.short: Establishing schools, dormitories, and vocational courses to support education at every level.
education.description: Education is the most powerful tool for social transformation. We aim to strengthen educational infrastructure by establishing secondary and higher education institutions, vocational courses, and dormitories.

scholarship.title: Scholarships & Academic Incentives
scholarship.short: Providing scholarships, internships, and professional development opportunities to students in need.
scholarship.description: Every talented student deserves educational opportunity. We organize scholarship programs, internship opportunities, and professional development seminars.

culture.title: Culture & Arts
culture.short: From festivals and exhibitions to museums and cultural centers — preserving our cultural heritage.
culture.description: Culture is the identity of a society. We organize national and international events to preserve, develop, and pass on our tangible and intangible cultural heritage.

solidarity.title: Social Solidarity
solidarity.short: Providing social support programs, emergency aid, and rehabilitation services to disadvantaged individuals.
solidarity.description: We work to ensure no one is left behind. We develop comprehensive support programs for disadvantaged groups in education, health, housing, and employment.

international.title: International Partnerships
international.short: Creating global impact through joint projects with the EU, UN, and international organizations.
international.description: We are stronger together. We grow our impact by establishing strategic partnerships with national and international organizations in education, culture, and social solidarity.

digital.title: Digital Education & Technology
digital.short: Bringing education into the future with AI, AR/VR, and distance learning platforms.
digital.description: In the digital age, education transcends borders. We aim to make education accessible to everyone through distance learning platforms, AI-powered learning environments, and digital libraries.

research.title: Scientific Research & Publishing
research.short: Contributing to knowledge production and dissemination through conferences, symposia, and publications.
research.description: Scientific research is the foundation of sustainable development. We contribute to knowledge production by supporting research projects, publishing, and organizing scientific events.

social_services.title: Social Services
social_services.short: Supporting the most vulnerable with health screenings, psychosocial support, and vocational rehabilitation.
social_services.description: Meeting basic human needs is our primary responsibility. We provide comprehensive and sustainable social services to disadvantaged communities.

construction.title: Social Infrastructure
construction.short: Building cultural centers, sports facilities, ecological parks, and community spaces.
construction.description: Physical spaces form the infrastructure of community life. We contribute to social development by building accessible, sustainable, and inclusive social spaces.

about.hero_subtitle: A Family's Word, A Society's Legacy
about.story_p1: The Öniz family sought to formalize its generational tradition of solidarity, philanthropy and social responsibility under a new institutional structure.
about.story_p2: 24 family members came together in Ankara with a shared question: "How can we deliver our resources to those who need them most, in a lasting way?"
about.story_p3: The answer was ÖNİZLER FOUNDATION. Registered by the Ankara West 10th Civil Court of First Instance (Decision No. E:2025/502, K:2026/81 dated 06.04.2026) and officially announced in the Turkish Official Gazette No. 33292 on 26 June 2026.
about.story_p4: Today Önizler Foundation stands as a pioneering civil society organization built on knowledge, innovation and sustainability. It operates across 9 activity areas defined in our charter with proactive, scientific and innovative methodologies.
about.story_p5: We believe that individual efforts, transformed into a collective force, create a lasting legacy of social welfare and progress. "Pioneer for Society, Legacy for the Future" — Önizler Foundation is the institutional embodiment of this belief.
about.mission_text: To produce rooted and sustainable solutions to society's macro needs in the social, cultural, scientific and ecological fields; to defend absolute equality of opportunity in education and support the qualified human capital that will build the future through academic and mentorship networks; and to strengthen social solidarity mechanisms with the principle of transparency, leaving lasting material and moral marks for future generations.
about.vision_text: To lead a globally referenced civil society ecosystem — modern, inclusive and future-shaping — where social development is triggered through proactive, scientific and innovative methodologies, and where human values, social justice and equal opportunity are made sustainable.

scholarship.intro: Don't let financial conditions stand in the way of your education. Apply to our scholarship program.

Not receiving a full scholarship from another organization
scholarship.calendar_text: Application period and details will be announced soon.

faq.q: When can I apply for a scholarship?
faq.a: Application periods are announced each year on our website and social media accounts.

faq.q: How much is the scholarship amount?
faq.a: Scholarship amounts are determined based on the level of education and financial need.

faq.q: Can I apply if I receive a scholarship from another institution?
faq.a: Candidates not receiving a full scholarship may apply. Those with partial scholarships will be evaluated.

faq.q: How long does the scholarship last?
faq.a: Scholarships are awarded per academic year and renewed based on academic performance.
Results are communicated via email after the evaluation process is completed.
